report.summary: The single failure is a Page.goto timeout on /books, caused by a random delay of 0–8 seconds in list_books (app/main.py:150), which runs on every /books page render. The UI fixture caps navigation at 5 s, so roughly 3 in 8 loads should time out, which makes this flaky rather than a deterministic product bug. First step: remove or bound the random sleep in app/main.py, or give the app a deterministic delay for tests, then rerun the UI suite.

causes.title: Random 0–8 s sleep in list_books makes /books page loads exceed the 5 s navigation timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database (app/main.py:150). render_books() calls list_books() on every render of /books (app/main.py:256), so each page.goto('/books') takes an extra 0–8 s. tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7 sets the default Playwright timeout to 5000 ms, and BooksPage.open() calls page.goto('/books') (tests/support/pages.py:33-35). When the sleep draw exceeds about 5 s (roughly 3/8 of the time), goto fails with the timeout seen in the report. The test logic itself is correct and the API call succeeded before the navigation, so the outcome depends on chance and the same code can pass on a rerun. The test is not the cause, but it is the test that happens to hit the slow path. The failure is only one test here, but any other test that loads /books through the UI (for example test_added_book_is_listed, test_deleted_book_disappears, test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input) is exposed to the same flakiness in other runs. The random sleep appears to be an injected slowness, not an intended feature. No other sleep in app/ or tests/ explains the delay (the only other sleep is the 0.2 s poll in tests/conftest.py:41).
evidence: Error: "Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: - navigating to \"http://127.0.0.1:53126/books\", waiting until \"load\""
app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]), called from render_books() which serves GET /books (app/main.py:310-314)
tests/ui/conftest.py:4-7: autouse fixture fail_fast calls page.set_default_timeout(5000)
Search for sleep|random found only app/main.py:9, app/main.py:150, tests/conftest.py:41
Failure list shows a single failed test; the test passed in the same run's setup (api.create_book succeeded before goto).
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random delay from list_books in app/main.py:150 so the page renders immediately. If the slowness is meant to be tested, make it deterministic and controlled (for example an env-var-gated delay that is off by default) and have UI tests wait for the books list to load rather than relying on the goto load event. As a short-term mitigation, raise the navigation timeout for BooksPage.open() (page.goto(..., timeout=...)) or mark the UI tests that load /books with a retry, but that only hides the root cause. Rerun tests/ui several times after the change to confirm the flakiness is gone.
